name: Marie Sklodowska-Curie Doctoral Networks (MSCA DN) - doctoral candidate positions
amount: Employment contract with living allowance, mobility allowance and family/leave/special-needs allowances where applicable
other_rules: must not hold a doctorate at the recruitment date
must enrol in a doctoral programme
must not have lived or worked mainly in the recruiting country for more than 12 months in the 36 months before recruitment
industrial doctorates need at least 50% of time outside academia
notes: Not a single call: individual PhD positions (3-36 months, up to 48 for joint doctorates) are advertised by funded networks on EURAXESS throughout the year, each with its own deadline. Apply directly to the recruiting institution.
